content: #!/usr/bin/env bash # Layout preview of a report draft: page SVGs, page PNGs and one PDF, for review before the HWPX # approval gate. Needs the engine's node_modules (npm ci in engine/) and a headless Chromium # (CHROME=..., otherwise the first of: Playwright builds under /opt/pw-browsers or # ~/.cache/ms-playwright, chromium, chromium-browser, google-chrome on PATH). # REPORT_BASE= previews the draft appended to an existing report. # # /tools/preview_pdf.sh set -euo pipefail here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd) draft=$1 root=$2 out=$3 find_chrome() { for c in /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-*/chrome-linux*/chrome "$HOME"/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-*/chrome-linux*/chrome; do [ -x "$c" ] && { echo "$c"; return; } done for c in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { command -v "$c"; return; } done } chrome=${CHROME:-$(find_chrome)} [ -n "$chrome" ] && [ -x "$chrome" ] || { echo "no chromium; set CHROME" >&2; exit 69; } mkdir -p "$out" rm -f "$out"/page-*.svg "$out"/page-*.png "$out"/page-*.html node "$here/render_preview.mjs" "$draft" "$root" "$out" out=$(cd "$out" && pwd) { printf '\n' for s in "$out"/page-*.svg; do printf '\n' "$(basename "$s")"; done printf '\n' } > "$out/all.html" "$chrome" --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer \ --print-to-pdf="$out/preview.pdf" "file://$out/all.html" >/dev/null 2>&1 for s in "$out"/page-*.svg; do html="${s%.svg}.html" printf '' \ "$(basename "$s")" > "$html" "$chrome" --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=1111,1571 \ --screenshot="${s%.svg}.png" "file://$html" >/dev/null 2>&1 rm -f "$html" done echo "pages: $(ls "$out"/page-*.png | wc -l); pdf: $out/preview.pdf"
